title: Downtown sample screen (screen 7: the shelter street)
note: The level's golden screen, with your 26 Oct picks 1a and 4a. The houses now run on past the top of the screen at true scale: the ground floors you know, then two upper storeys of 3 m with one window drawn once and repeated on every storey (built from parts, 0 credits). The tram stop shelter (2.5 m) and the courtyard gateways (3 m) stand behind Pepper at true scale; her perches stay exactly where they were: the gate is a stack of bread crates, the shelter's top a baker's board on two stacks of crates. The dormer is a copper window hood. Nothing she stands on moved. Checks: PEPPER UNCHANGED, flow 125/125, Tiled, physics 102/102, QA 0 problems, autopilot GOOD GIRL, curve T1-T4 PASS, asset QA PASS on all 11 pieces.
question: On the high road the houses now fill the whole screen behind her, so the far roofs, the old town row and the spire show only where the street has gaps (screens 1-4, 6, 9-11). Keep the full-height street, or open gaps (lower houses) so the spire stays in view?
